Name: Probably Purple and Certainly Rainbows - Outdated
Author: kristyreal
Description: [u]Outdated![/u] This is a custom rainbow mod for Content Patcher. It includes custom recolored furniture,  machines, walls and floors, animals, farm building exteriors. trees, bushes, bus, shirts, hats and many craftable items, titles screens and dialog boxes. I remodeled the kitchen and made a rainbow bed as well. Lots of hidden gems so you'll have to play to find them all.

Downloads.Description: probablypurple.zip: Unzip into the mods folder of your game. Requires SMAPI and Content Patcher.
